languages.coverageRule: Measure availability and fallback per artifact; the district's support languages do not imply that every public artifact is translated.

vendor.name: California Department of Education
vendor.basis: Official CDE directory URL keyed by the district CDS entity code.

cadence.expectation: Check before identity or school-roster releases.

sources.archiveNotes: CDE warns that directory details are self-reported and may be stale; the displayed last-updated date is itself important provenance.

cadence.expectation: Monitor configured high-value pages rather than crawling every school site.

sources.archiveNotes: The site mixes current Simbli links with an inline historical meeting archive.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official board page and Finalsite footer.

cadence.expectation: Use as the discovery bridge and revisit meetings until minutes and recordings settle.

sources.archiveNotes: Inline history includes regular, special, study-session, closed-session, and school-visitation meetings; preserve those semantics.

vendor.name: Simbli
vendor.basis: Direct links from the official district governance page and stable Simbli site identifier.

cadence.expectation: Discover daily around scheduled meetings and reconcile publication state with the district page.

sources.archiveNotes: The listing exposes meeting types and agenda content; displayed minutes status must be checked against separately linked district minutes.

vendor.name: Agenda Online
vendor.basis: The official district page links Agenda Online records and identifies the historical years.

cadence.expectation: Use for backfill and cross-regime reconciliation.

sources.archiveNotes: The official page is the stable discovery source; individual Agenda Online links use AgencyID 127 and meeting-specific identifiers.

vendor.name: YouTube
vendor.basis: The official governance page links the SMFCSD Board of Trustees channel.

cadence.expectation: Discover after meetings and reconcile to the matching agenda and district-page recording link.

sources.archiveNotes: Not every special or visitation meeting necessarily has a recording; absence must be explicit, not inferred as failure.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official fiscal page on the district Finalsite site.

cadence.expectation: Check adopted budget, unaudited actuals, interim reports, and audit milestones.

sources.archiveNotes: Group documents by fiscal year and report type rather than page order or filename alone.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official calendar page and Finalsite footer.

cadence.expectation: Check each school year and compare PDF dates to the live event calendar.

sources.archiveNotes: Board-approved PDFs and the live calendar are separate representations and may change on different schedules.

vendor.name: Google
vendor.basis: The official calendar page publishes this subscription URL.

cadence.expectation: Fetch with retrieval time and compare event identifiers and dates to the official page.

sources.archiveNotes: A live feed is not an immutable school-year snapshot; snapshot before deriving changes.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Current official menu page publishes dated menu and carbohydrate-count documents.

cadence.expectation: Discover monthly menu bundles and preserve school or program applicability.

sources.archiveNotes: Current official evidence exposes district PDFs. A previously suggested LINQ source is not considered confirmed until the district links it.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official language-services page on the district Finalsite site.

cadence.expectation: Recheck stated support languages and service policy before each pilot release.

sources.archiveNotes: The page states that Spanish, Chinese, and Japanese met the district's described threshold as of 2024; preserve that effective-date qualifier.

sourceRegimes.notes: The district page exposes Agenda Online records through June 2022 and history at least to the 2019-20 school year; the earlier bound is unknown.
The official archive links August 2022 agendas to Simbli; no exact contractual cutover date is asserted.

sampleTargets.selection: Meetings across Agenda Online and Simbli: regular, special, study-session, closed-session, and school-visitation examples.
Compare Simbli minutes status, separately linked district minutes, agenda state, and YouTube availability.
Adopted budget, interim reports, unaudited actuals, and audit where available.
Reconcile board-approved PDF, public iCalendar feed, and live Finalsite events.
Reconcile official district PDFs by school/program; test any vendor feed only after a current official link confirms it.
Balance factual correctness, temporal correctness, source support, agenda semantics, school/program identity, budget interpretation, terminology, translation usefulness, and actionability.

successSignals: The same shared Simbli adapter handles RCSD, Ravenswood, and SMFCSD through configuration.
Agenda Online history and Simbli records reconcile without flattening meeting types.
Language coverage is reported per artifact for English, Spanish, Chinese, and Japanese.
Accepted expert corrections point to publishable sources and become reusable fixtures or rules.

openQuestions: Confirm whether a live LINQ or other menu feed remains an official district source; the current menu page exposes PDFs and does not establish that vendor.
Identify the complete Agenda Online archive bound before the 2019-20 records shown on the district page.
Determine the Chinese script or locale per artifact instead of assigning one at district level.
Inventory governing committees and distinguish board study sessions from advisory-body meetings.
Have an authorized human coordinate any expert review; this manifest does not authorize outreach.
